obligations.title: Provide Statement of Work services using suitably qualified personnel.
Keep Confidential Information confidential for the term and 3 years after.
Execute a Data Processing Agreement before any personal data is processed.
Process personal data only on the Customer's documented instructions and under data protection law.
Escalate disputes to senior management for resolution within 15 days, then mediate before court action.
Do not solicit the other party's service personnel during the term and 12 months after.
